name: Nova Reyes
bio: Night-shift DJ and amateur astronomer from Toronto. Nova dresses for the walk home at 4 AM: oversized, warm and always one chrome detail. Collects vinyl and constellations.

look.face: Oval face, warm olive skin, dark brown eyes, a small beauty mark under the left eye
look.hair: Jet-black blunt bob with a short fringe
look.signature_detail: A single chrome star ear cuff on the right ear

world.voice: Short lowercase captions, one emoji at most

image_rules.consistency: Same bob, beauty mark and star ear cuff every time
